result: PTEN mutant cells strongly overproliferate specifically under nutrient restriction, switching from hypertrophic to hyperplastic growth. Under starvation, PTEN clones massively increase in size through increased cell number rather than cell size, with the overgrowth phenotype fully apparent 60 hours after clone induction and requiring early starvation exposure (within 48 hours) to manifest.

result: PTEN mutant cells critically depend on the amino acid transporter Slimfast for survival under starvation.
